propositions: test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer intermittently kills its pytest-xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to exceeding the 300s per-test timeout
the test walks the entire corpus (884 units) in a single monolithic loop, spawning ~1768 serial pandoc processes, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation (1.7x past the 300s guard)
pytest-timeout with thread method calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the worker process outright without traceback or assertion text rather than failing the test
the macOS CI cell is contended and under load, causing the unbounded serial cost to exceed the per-test budget routinely while ubuntu cells remain healthy
the fix chunks the test into fixed-size batches (40 units per chunk) parametrized by pytest, bounding per-test cost to ~4s idle and preventing corpus growth from re-crossing the timeout
a new coverage guard test asserts all chunks reassemble to the full corpus (884 units, >= 100) with _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE still 1 and real pandoc on both sides
